name: red-new-session-single-bar-and-gaps
note: G1 design §9, item 4: a single-bar session, a weekend gap and a missing day in one dataset. IST days 07-23 (2 bars), 07-24 (1 bar), 07-27 (2 bars, 07-25/26 are the weekend), 07-29 (2 bars, 07-28 missing). What matters is localDayKey differences, not bar spacing, so a gap is not a session boundary in its own right -- it just means the next bar carries a different day key. The single-bar session at index 2 is the discriminator for the §3 scan-start exception: scanning from s+1 instead of s would test bar 3 first (same day as bar 4, predicate false), then bar 4 (boundary to 07-29, true), yielding x2bar=4 -- an object spanning three sessions instead of the one bar it belongs to.
